summary: PAVmed Inc. disclosed an at-the-market issuance arrangement on a routine Form 8-K dated September 9, 2026. The Company signed a Sales Agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners as sales agent, permitting sales of common stock from time to time under an effective Form S-3 shelf, capped at $9,400,000 of shares per the prospectus supplement. The agent earns a 3.0% commission plus expense reimbursements up to $65,000 upfront, $7,500 quarterly, and $12,500 per program refresh. Proceeds are earmarked for working capital and general corporate purposes. No valuation, premium, or target is involved. Watch offering pace and dilution pressure.
